The main takeaway from our work is that

the inclusion of low‐resolution structural information in the form restraints can accelerate the determination and/or refinement of protein structure in MD simulation, and that this acceleration can be achieved with a relatively modest amount of information, which can often already be inferred from bioinformatic or experimental studies.
